The main takeaway from our work is that
the best mitigation strategy for a country is a combination of a strict lockdown for the initial period of the epidemic followed by a gradual release of the restrictions.

in order to reduce the total number of deaths, it is important to reduce the peak of the epidemic, and to do it quickly, by implementing a strict lockdown, and not by prolonging the epidemic over time, by applying less strict measures.

the best mitigation strategy is a hybrid one where lockdown is held until the number of available respiratory ventilators per patient is at least 10 and the epidemic growth rate is below 0.5 per week, and then lockdown is released.
